**Macro calendar — week ahead**

- **Edition:** Sunday edition (forward week)
- **Issued:** 2026-11-01 15:0x ET / 2026-11-01 20:0x UTC

**TL;DR**

- **Tier 1 events this week: 3** — all on **Friday Nov 6, 8:30 ET** (Nonfarm Payrolls, Unemployment Rate, Average Hourly Earnings).
- There is **no CPI, no PPI, no PCE, no GDP and no FOMC decision** inside this window.
- **No FOMC meeting.** The last meeting was **Oct 27–28** (statement Oct 28: held 3.75%–4.00%, 10–2 vote, Hammack dissenting for a hike).
- The next decision is **Wed Dec 9**; **FOMC minutes land Wed Nov 18**. Any calendar showing a "rate decision" on Nov 4 is wrong.
- **Biggest risk day: Friday Nov 6** (`HIGH_IMPACT_DAY`) — the only Tier 1 day, and it lands two sessions after the election.
- **Second-biggest: Wednesday Nov 4** (`ELEVATED_IMPACT_DAY`) — **Treasury quarterly refunding statement 8:30 ET** (the long-end catalyst:
- Citi expects 20y/30y auction sizes trimmed by $3bn each) + ISM Services + ADP + trade balance.
- **Third: Tuesday Nov 3** (`ELEVATED_IMPACT_DAY`) — **US midterm elections** + JOLTS + factory orders. Election results are the week's real macro event; the data releases are secondary.
- **Fed speakers: 7 across 4 days** (Mon, Thu ×3, Fri ×3). Three of the seven are 2026 FOMC voters, one of them (Hammack) dissented at the last meeting.
- **Not in this window:** retail sales, durable goods, new/existing/pending home sales, industrial production, CB consumer confidence, TIC, Beige Book. First of those lands after the Nov 11 holiday.

**Treasury calendar**

- **Date**: Mon Nov 2 · **Event**: 3-Month and 6-Month Bill auctions · **Detail**: 11:30 ET
- **Date**: Tue Nov 3 · **Event**: 6-Week Bill auction · **Detail**: 11:30 ET
- **Date**: Wed Nov 4 · **Event**: Quarterly Refunding Statement (8:30 ET)
- **Detail**: Q4 financing estimates released Mon 3:00 PM ET. Watch for changes to the "maintaining nominal coupon and FRN auction sizes for at least the next several quarters" language, long-end buyback sizes, and any move to the 20y/30y auction sizes. Citi's Jason Williams team expects 20y and 30y sizes cut by $3bn each; Barclays expects no TIPS size change (Nov 10y TIPS reopening $19bn, Dec 5y $24bn, Jan 10y $21bn).
- **Date**: Wed Nov 4 · **Event**: 3-Year and 10-Year note auction announcement
- **Detail**: Per Treasury's tentative schedule the 3-year auctions Mon Nov 9 and the 10-year Tue Nov 10 — sizes are set at the Nov 4 statement, not yet published.
- **Date**: Thu Nov 5 · **Event**: 8-Week Bill auction · **Detail**: 11:30 ET

**No 2y/5y/7y/10y/20y/30y coupon auction falls inside this week** — the coupon calendar is a next-week-and-beyond story. Any calendar showing a coupon auction Mon Nov 2–Thu Nov 5 is misdated.
